The AsOfMode provides three perspectives: transactional (what was known), evidential (what happened), and combined (strict bitemporal). The most recent evidence wins rule ensures that corrections or new insights override stale data without violating causality. Freshness decay enforces that only events occurring before or at the reconstruction point are considered. These primitives together form a dual-time logic that supports both epistemic inference and situational reasoning, preventing data corruption from NaNs or future timestamps by enforcing strict ordering and validation.
